remarks: Beautifully maintained townhouse offering comfort and style, in a meticulously cared-for complex. The spacious eat-in kitchen features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances., and a pantry. This inviting home includes 2 generously sized beds and 2.5 baths, with hardwood floors throughout.  The living room features a charming wood-burning fireplace, creating the perfect setting for cozy evenings at home. Additional highlights include a new garage door, a private patio with beautiful plantings, that reflect pride of ownership.  Enjoy beautifully landscaped grounds and exceptional complex maintenance, including recently completed new roof and new hardie board siding ,adding both value and peace of mind. Residents also enjoy access to the complex swimming pool.
